name: jellyfin
title: Jellyfin media server
description: Streams your own movies, music and photos from the data disk.
external: Metadata providers (TheMovieDb, MusicBrainz, ...) and plugin repository when online; disable them in the Jellyfin library settings for fully offline use
resources: ~200-400 MB RAM idle; transcoding is CPU heavy on a Raspberry Pi, prefer direct play
notes: Put media under DATA_DIR/media and open http://media.<domain> to create the admin account.
